customSections.label: Does This Calendar Apply to My School?
customSections.content: This page follows the CMS Traditional Calendar for 2026–27. CMS also publishes separate calendars for CPCC early colleges and middle colleges, UNC Charlotte early colleges, Hawthorne Academy of Health Sciences, and A/B day schedules. If your student attends one of those programs, use that program's official calendar instead.

customSections.label: CMS 2026–27 Grading Period End Dates
customSections.content: CMS lists four grading periods on the 2026–27 Traditional Calendar. These are academic milestones, not days off or early release days.

customSections.label: Major Breaks and Long No-School Windows
customSections.content: CMS's official break labels do not always show the full stretch of days students are away from school. These windows combine adjacent teacher workdays, holidays, and weekends.

groups.label: Thanksgiving
items: Official Thanksgiving Break is November 26–27. Students are also off Wednesday, November 25 for a teacher workday, creating a November 25–29 no-school window including the weekend.

groups.label: Winter Break
items: Winter Break runs December 21 through January 1. Students return Monday, January 4, 2027.

groups.label: Spring Break
items: Spring Break runs March 29–April 2, with Good Friday on March 26. March 25 is scheduled as a teacher workday but is also CMS's third-listed makeup day. If CMS does not use it as a makeup day, students are scheduled to be out from March 25 through April 4, including the weekends, and return Monday, April 5.

customSections.label: CMS Makeup Day Order
customSections.content: CMS lists five possible makeup days, in this order. A listed date becomes an instructional day only if the district activates it to make up missed school. The superintendent may waive up to four makeup days, and state law also allows remote instruction for certain emergency closures.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: Spring Break moves from April 6–10 in 2025–26 to March 29–April 2 in 2026–27.
The scheduled last day moves from June 10 in 2026 to June 9 in 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CMS start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day on the CMS 2026–27 Traditional Calendar is Tuesday, August 25, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CMS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: CMS Spring Break runs March 29–April 2, 2027, with Good Friday on March 26. March 25 is a scheduled teacher workday and the third-listed makeup day. If CMS does not use it as a makeup day, students are scheduled to be out March 25–April 4 and return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CMS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break on the CMS Traditional Calendar runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When are CMS teacher workdays with no school?
calendarFaqs.a: After the first day of school, the CMS Traditional Calendar lists teacher workdays on September 21, October 2, November 2–3, November 25, January 22, February 15, and March 25. February 15 and March 25 are also possible makeup days, so families should check CMS updates after a closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When are CMS early release days?
calendarFaqs.a: The four districtwide early release days are October 14, December 9, February 24, and April 28. Dismissal times vary by school level, so check the current CMS bell schedule or your school's notice.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every CMS school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page follows the CMS Traditional Calendar. CMS publishes separate 2026–27 calendars for CPCC early colleges and middle colleges, UNC Charlotte early colleges, Hawthorne Academy of Health Sciences, and A/B day schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens to the calendar if CMS closes for bad weather?
calendarFaqs.a: CMS may close schools, open on a two-hour delay, dismiss early, or use remote learning during severe weather. Check the CMS Inclement Weather page, the district homepage, and ParentSquare for current announcements. The Traditional Calendar lists possible makeup dates in a specific order.
